Current stock: 12× 1-litre Weck, 6× 500 ml Fido with the rubber ring,
3× old Kilner with the wire bales. The Fido rings perished this year —
order replacements; the jars themselves are fine.

The Weck jars are the workhorses for ferments: wide mouth for packing,
glass lid that does not corrode in brine. The Kilner bales are
moody — use them only for dry storage where a failed seal is a
nuisance rather than a disaster.

Do not buy more jars. The problem was never jar count, it was always
jar organisation.
